{{Short description|Finnish mathematician (1894–1977)}}
[[File:Frithiof-Nevanlinna-1964.jpg|thumb|right|Frithiof Nevanlinna in 1964.]]
'''Frithiof Edvard Henrik Nevanlinna''' (16 August 1894 – 20 March 1977) was a [[Finland|Finnish]] [[mathematician]] and professor who worked on classical and [[complex analysis]]. He was born in [[Joensuu]], and was the older brother of mathematician [[Rolf Nevanlinna]].
